charizard_facets.sql: select count(*) records,count(distinct c.language||':'||c.set_code||':'||c.collector_number) coordinates from card c join card_facet f on f.card_id=c.card_id where c.language='ja' and f.facet_type='dex_id' and f.value='6'

charizard_examples.sql: select c.card_id,c.name,c.provenance from card c join card_facet f on f.card_id=c.card_id where c.language='ja' and f.facet_type='dex_id' and f.value='6' limit 5

pikachu_yuka_intersection.sql: select c.card_id,c.name from card c join card_facet d on d.card_id=c.card_id and d.facet_type='dex_id' and d.value='25' join card_facet f on f.card_id=c.card_id and f.facet_type='illustrator' and f.value='Yuka Morii' where c.language='ja'

sv2a_coordinates.sql: select count(*) records,count(distinct collector_number) coordinates from card where language='ja' and set_code='SV2A'

sv4a_not_mew_known.sql: select count(*) records,count(distinct c.collector_number) coordinates from card c where language='ja' and set_code='SV4A' and exists(select 1 from card_facet f where f.card_id=c.card_id and facet_type='dex_id' and value!='151') and not exists(select 1 from card_facet f where f.card_id=c.card_id and facet_type='dex_id' and value='151')

pikachu_not_owned.sql: select count(*) records,count(distinct c.set_code||':'||c.collector_number) coordinates from card c join card_facet f on f.card_id=c.card_id where c.language='ja' and f.facet_type='dex_id' and f.value='25' and c.card_id!='ja:SV4A:236/190:holo'

mew_comparison_metadata.sql: select c.card_id,c.name,c.rarity,c.provenance,f.facet_type,f.value,f.provenance facet_provenance from card c left join card_facet f on f.card_id=c.card_id where c.card_id in ('ja:SV4A:327/190:holo','ja:SV4A:347/190:holo')

pikachu_yuka_all_evidence_intersection.sql: select c.card_id,c.name,f.value artist_source_value from card c left join card_facet f on f.card_id=c.card_id and f.facet_type='illustrator' where c.language='ja' and (exists(select 1 from card_facet cf where cf.card_id=c.card_id and cf.facet_type='dex_id' and cf.value='25') or exists(select 1 from card_metadata_evidence me where me.card_id=c.card_id and json_extract(me.record_json,'$.official.dex_id')=25)) and (exists(select 1 from card_facet af where af.card_id=c.card_id and af.facet_type='illustrator' and af.value='Yuka Morii') or exists(select 1 from card_metadata_evidence me,json_each(me.record_json,'$.official.illustrators') j where me.card_id=c.card_id and j.value='Yuka Morii') or exists(select 1 from source_correction_evidence ce where ce.language=c.language and ce.set_code=c.set_code and ce.collector_number=c.collector_number and ce.kind='printed_artist' and json_extract(ce.record_json,'$.value')='Yuka Morii'))
pikachu_yuka_all_evidence_intersection.note: Broad union of raw and official dex facets and raw/official/correction artist evidence is empty, so precedence cannot produce a direct-facet intersection.
